mechanics.name: Kill the Shaman First
mechanics.desc: A band of raiders is held together by a shaman in their midst: while the shaman lives the others shrug off most blows, so the fight is won by whoever picks the right target.
mechanics.flavor: Always kill the shaman first.

mechanics.name: Kill the Shaman First: The Iron Shaman
mechanics.desc: A band of raiders is held together by a shaman in their midst: while the shaman lives the others shrug off most blows, so the fight is won by whoever picks the right target. The tether is nearly total: 95 per cent of every blow on a follower is turned aside.
mechanics.flavor: Always kill the shaman first.

mechanics.name: Kill the Shaman First: Omen
mechanics.desc: A band of raiders is held together by a shaman in their midst: while the shaman lives the others shrug off most blows, so the fight is won by whoever picks the right target. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: Always kill the shaman first.

mechanics.name: Kill the Shaman First: Keystone
mechanics.desc: A band of raiders is held together by a shaman in their midst: while the shaman lives the others shrug off most blows, so the fight is won by whoever picks the right target. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: Always kill the shaman first.

mechanics.name: Kill the Shaman First: A Thin Thread
mechanics.desc: A band of raiders is held together by a shaman in their midst: while the shaman lives the others shrug off most blows, so the fight is won by whoever picks the right target. A loose bond: the followers are harder to kill, but not impossible.
mechanics.flavor: Always kill the shaman first.

mechanics.name: Kill the Shaman First: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: A band of raiders is held together by a shaman in their midst: while the shaman lives the others shrug off most blows, so the fight is won by whoever picks the right target. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: Always kill the shaman first.

mechanics.name: Kill the Shaman First: Endurance
mechanics.desc: A band of raiders is held together by a shaman in their midst: while the shaman lives the others shrug off most blows, so the fight is won by whoever picks the right target. Last out the time and it ends by itself.
mechanics.flavor: Always kill the shaman first.

mechanics.name: The Barrier and the Switch
mechanics.desc: The room's guardians are inside a barrier no blade can pierce, and somewhere in the room a switch holds the key: the party that finds it first and pulls it wins the fight before it starts.
mechanics.flavor: You have to read the room before you can swing at it.

mechanics.name: The Barrier and the Switch: The Flickering Barrier
mechanics.desc: The room's guardians are inside a barrier no blade can pierce, and somewhere in the room a switch holds the key: the party that finds it first and pulls it wins the fight before it starts. The barrier flickers: it drops by itself for a few seconds now and then.
mechanics.flavor: You have to read the room before you can swing at it.

mechanics.name: The Barrier and the Switch: Omen
mechanics.desc: The room's guardians are inside a barrier no blade can pierce, and somewhere in the room a switch holds the key: the party that finds it first and pulls it wins the fight before it starts. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: You have to read the room before you can swing at it.

mechanics.name: The Barrier and the Switch: Sequenced
mechanics.desc: The room's guardians are inside a barrier no blade can pierce, and somewhere in the room a switch holds the key: the party that finds it first and pulls it wins the fight before it starts. Use its pedestals in the right order to end it.
mechanics.flavor: You have to read the room before you can swing at it.

mechanics.name: The Barrier and the Switch: Barrier of Pillars
mechanics.desc: The room's guardians are inside a barrier no blade can pierce, and somewhere in the room a switch holds the key: the party that finds it first and pulls it wins the fight before it starts. Three pillars hold the barrier up and all three must be lit together.
mechanics.flavor: You have to read the room before you can swing at it.

mechanics.name: The Barrier and the Switch: Altar
mechanics.desc: The room's guardians are inside a barrier no blade can pierce, and somewhere in the room a switch holds the key: the party that finds it first and pulls it wins the fight before it starts. It needs a hand on its altar block to begin.
mechanics.flavor: You have to read the room before you can swing at it.

mechanics.name: The Barrier and the Switch: Keystone
mechanics.desc: The room's guardians are inside a barrier no blade can pierce, and somewhere in the room a switch holds the key: the party that finds it first and pulls it wins the fight before it starts. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: You have to read the room before you can swing at it.

mechanics.name: Spell Turning
mechanics.desc: The creatures in the hall wear the mark of a reflecting ward: whatever hits them hits back, a good part of the pain thrown back at whoever delivered it.
mechanics.flavor: The more you hurt it, the more it hurts you.

mechanics.name: Spell Turning: The Mirror Carapace
mechanics.desc: The creatures in the hall wear the mark of a reflecting ward: whatever hits them hits back, a good part of the pain thrown back at whoever delivered it. A mirror carapace: three quarters comes back.
mechanics.flavor: The more you hurt it, the more it hurts you.

mechanics.name: Spell Turning: Omen
mechanics.desc: The creatures in the hall wear the mark of a reflecting ward: whatever hits them hits back, a good part of the pain thrown back at whoever delivered it. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: The more you hurt it, the more it hurts you.

mechanics.name: Spell Turning: Keystone
mechanics.desc: The creatures in the hall wear the mark of a reflecting ward: whatever hits them hits back, a good part of the pain thrown back at whoever delivered it. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: The more you hurt it, the more it hurts you.

mechanics.name: Spell Turning: A Flickering Ward
mechanics.desc: The creatures in the hall wear the mark of a reflecting ward: whatever hits them hits back, a good part of the pain thrown back at whoever delivered it. The ward only holds in short bursts, leaving long gaps in which a quick hand hits freely.
mechanics.flavor: The more you hurt it, the more it hurts you.

mechanics.name: Spell Turning: Backlash
mechanics.desc: The creatures in the hall wear the mark of a reflecting ward: whatever hits them hits back, a good part of the pain thrown back at whoever delivered it. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
mechanics.flavor: The more you hurt it, the more it hurts you.

mechanics.name: Spell Turning: Endurance
mechanics.desc: The creatures in the hall wear the mark of a reflecting ward: whatever hits them hits back, a good part of the pain thrown back at whoever delivered it. Last out the time and it ends by itself.
mechanics.flavor: The more you hurt it, the more it hurts you.

mechanics.name: The Wave Over the Wall
mechanics.desc: The hall is a bulwark and the enemy comes in waves, each larger than the last, with a calm in between that is only for catching breath.
mechanics.flavor: The wall has stood for a hundred years. Today we will see why.

effects.text: A wave comes over the wall!

mechanics.name: The Wave Over the Wall: The Dead Wave
mechanics.desc: The hall is a bulwark and the enemy comes in waves, each larger than the last, with a calm in between that is only for catching breath. The waves are the unquiet dead.
mechanics.flavor: The wall has stood for a hundred years. Today we will see why.

effects.text: A wave comes over the wall!

mechanics.name: The Wave Over the Wall: Omen
mechanics.desc: The hall is a bulwark and the enemy comes in waves, each larger than the last, with a calm in between that is only for catching breath. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: The wall has stood for a hundred years. Today we will see why.

effects.text: A wave comes over the wall!

mechanics.name: The Wave Over the Wall: Warded
mechanics.desc: The hall is a bulwark and the enemy comes in waves, each larger than the last, with a calm in between that is only for catching breath. It is held up by wardens that spawn with it; kill them all to end it.
mechanics.flavor: The wall has stood for a hundred years. Today we will see why.

effects.text: A wave comes over the wall!

mechanics.name: The Wave Over the Wall: A Great Wave
mechanics.desc: The hall is a bulwark and the enemy comes in waves, each larger than the last, with a calm in between that is only for catching breath. Fewer waves and each heavier.
mechanics.flavor: The wall has stood for a hundred years. Today we will see why.

effects.text: A wave comes over the wall!

mechanics.name: The Wave Over the Wall: Quorum
mechanics.desc: The hall is a bulwark and the enemy comes in waves, each larger than the last, with a calm in between that is only for catching breath. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
mechanics.flavor: The wall has stood for a hundred years. Today we will see why.

effects.text: A wave comes over the wall!

mechanics.name: The Wave Over the Wall: Switch
mechanics.desc: The hall is a bulwark and the enemy comes in waves, each larger than the last, with a calm in between that is only for catching breath. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: The wall has stood for a hundred years. Today we will see why.

effects.text: A wave comes over the wall!

mechanics.name: The Cursed Spear
mechanics.desc: The weapons on the arena floor were never meant to be used: whoever swings a blade in this room feels the old curse bite the hand that holds it.
mechanics.flavor: A spear that never fails to wound, and never fails to wound its wielder.

mechanics.name: The Cursed Spear: The Heavy Curse
mechanics.desc: The weapons on the arena floor were never meant to be used: whoever swings a blade in this room feels the old curse bite the hand that holds it. A heavier curse: each swing costs twice the blood.
mechanics.flavor: A spear that never fails to wound, and never fails to wound its wielder.

mechanics.name: The Cursed Spear: Omen
mechanics.desc: The weapons on the arena floor were never meant to be used: whoever swings a blade in this room feels the old curse bite the hand that holds it. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: A spear that never fails to wound, and never fails to wound its wielder.

mechanics.name: The Cursed Spear: Keystone
mechanics.desc: The weapons on the arena floor were never meant to be used: whoever swings a blade in this room feels the old curse bite the hand that holds it. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: A spear that never fails to wound, and never fails to wound its wielder.

mechanics.name: The Cursed Spear: The Hungry Spear
mechanics.desc: The weapons on the arena floor were never meant to be used: whoever swings a blade in this room feels the old curse bite the hand that holds it. The spear also drinks mana with each wound.
mechanics.flavor: A spear that never fails to wound, and never fails to wound its wielder.

mechanics.name: The Cursed Spear: Backlash
mechanics.desc: The weapons on the arena floor were never meant to be used: whoever swings a blade in this room feels the old curse bite the hand that holds it. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
mechanics.flavor: A spear that never fails to wound, and never fails to wound its wielder.

mechanics.name: The Cursed Spear: Blood-tithe
mechanics.desc: The weapons on the arena floor were never meant to be used: whoever swings a blade in this room feels the old curse bite the hand that holds it. Pay in hearts at the altar to end it.
mechanics.flavor: A spear that never fails to wound, and never fails to wound its wielder.

mechanics.name: The Turf War Spills Over
mechanics.desc: Two monster factions have been fighting over this chamber and the party stumbles into their quarrel: every kill draws a response from the rival band, and the Dungeon Master takes an interest.
mechanics.flavor: In a monster nation, even the squabbles are politics.

mechanics.name: The Turf War Spills Over: The Undead Quarrel
mechanics.desc: Two monster factions have been fighting over this chamber and the party stumbles into their quarrel: every kill draws a response from the rival band, and the Dungeon Master takes an interest. The quarrel is among the dead.
mechanics.flavor: In a monster nation, even the squabbles are politics.

mechanics.name: The Turf War Spills Over: Omen
mechanics.desc: Two monster factions have been fighting over this chamber and the party stumbles into their quarrel: every kill draws a response from the rival band, and the Dungeon Master takes an interest. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: In a monster nation, even the squabbles are politics.

mechanics.name: The Turf War Spills Over: Endurance
mechanics.desc: Two monster factions have been fighting over this chamber and the party stumbles into their quarrel: every kill draws a response from the rival band, and the Dungeon Master takes an interest. Last out the time and it ends by itself.
mechanics.flavor: In a monster nation, even the squabbles are politics.

mechanics.name: The Turf War Spills Over: The Angry Quarrel
mechanics.desc: Two monster factions have been fighting over this chamber and the party stumbles into their quarrel: every kill draws a response from the rival band, and the Dungeon Master takes an interest. The rival band comes in already angry.
mechanics.flavor: In a monster nation, even the squabbles are politics.

mechanics.name: The Turf War Spills Over: Backlash
mechanics.desc: Two monster factions have been fighting over this chamber and the party stumbles into their quarrel: every kill draws a response from the rival band, and the Dungeon Master takes an interest. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
mechanics.flavor: In a monster nation, even the squabbles are politics.

mechanics.name: The Ambush
mechanics.desc: A quiet room with nobody in it, until the door closes: the monsters were waiting in the dark on all sides, for as long as it took the delvers to wander in.
mechanics.flavor: Surprise round. Roll for initiative. Not that you needed to.

mechanics.name: The Ambush: A Bandit Ambush
mechanics.desc: A quiet room with nobody in it, until the door closes: the monsters were waiting in the dark on all sides, for as long as it took the delvers to wander in. The ambushers are knights of the road.
mechanics.flavor: Surprise round. Roll for initiative. Not that you needed to.

mechanics.name: The Ambush: Omen
mechanics.desc: A quiet room with nobody in it, until the door closes: the monsters were waiting in the dark on all sides, for as long as it took the delvers to wander in. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: Surprise round. Roll for initiative. Not that you needed to.

mechanics.name: The Ambush: Endurance
mechanics.desc: A quiet room with nobody in it, until the door closes: the monsters were waiting in the dark on all sides, for as long as it took the delvers to wander in. Last out the time and it ends by itself.
mechanics.flavor: Surprise round. Roll for initiative. Not that you needed to.

mechanics.name: The Ambush: A Web Ambush
mechanics.desc: A quiet room with nobody in it, until the door closes: the monsters were waiting in the dark on all sides, for as long as it took the delvers to wander in. The ambushers drop out of the ceiling on silk.
mechanics.flavor: Surprise round. Roll for initiative. Not that you needed to.

mechanics.name: The Ambush: Hush
mechanics.desc: A quiet room with nobody in it, until the door closes: the monsters were waiting in the dark on all sides, for as long as it took the delvers to wander in. Crouching in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Surprise round. Roll for initiative. Not that you needed to.

mechanics.name: The Clone Duel
mechanics.desc: Every delver finds themselves face to face with a copy that wields the same gear and the same habits: win by understanding yourself better than your copy does.
mechanics.flavor: The one who knows your jutsu is you.

mechanics.name: The Clone Duel: A Hundred Clones
mechanics.desc: Every delver finds themselves face to face with a copy that wields the same gear and the same habits: win by understanding yourself better than your copy does. More clones, weaker each.
mechanics.flavor: The one who knows your jutsu is you.

mechanics.name: The Clone Duel: Omen
mechanics.desc: Every delver finds themselves face to face with a copy that wields the same gear and the same habits: win by understanding yourself better than your copy does. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: The one who knows your jutsu is you.

mechanics.name: The Clone Duel: Endurance
mechanics.desc: Every delver finds themselves face to face with a copy that wields the same gear and the same habits: win by understanding yourself better than your copy does. Last out the time and it ends by itself.
mechanics.flavor: The one who knows your jutsu is you.

mechanics.name: The Clone Duel: The Swap
mechanics.desc: Every delver finds themselves face to face with a copy that wields the same gear and the same habits: win by understanding yourself better than your copy does. Clones that swap places with a monster of the room at random.
mechanics.flavor: The one who knows your jutsu is you.

mechanics.name: The Clone Duel: Quorum
mechanics.desc: Every delver finds themselves face to face with a copy that wields the same gear and the same habits: win by understanding yourself better than your copy does. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
mechanics.flavor: The one who knows your jutsu is you.

mechanics.name: The Splitting Gel
mechanics.desc: A great gelatinous thing and the knowledge that every blow that kills it makes two smaller ones: the smart party fights with fire and patience, the other with a sword.
mechanics.flavor: Never feed a slime after midnight, they said.

mechanics.name: The Splitting Gel: The Three-Way Split
mechanics.desc: A great gelatinous thing and the knowledge that every blow that kills it makes two smaller ones: the smart party fights with fire and patience, the other with a sword. Three smaller ones each time.
mechanics.flavor: Never feed a slime after midnight, they said.

mechanics.name: The Splitting Gel: Omen
mechanics.desc: A great gelatinous thing and the knowledge that every blow that kills it makes two smaller ones: the smart party fights with fire and patience, the other with a sword. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: Never feed a slime after midnight, they said.

mechanics.name: The Splitting Gel: Keystone
mechanics.desc: A great gelatinous thing and the knowledge that every blow that kills it makes two smaller ones: the smart party fights with fire and patience, the other with a sword. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: Never feed a slime after midnight, they said.

mechanics.name: The Splitting Gel: The Acid Gel
mechanics.desc: A great gelatinous thing and the knowledge that every blow that kills it makes two smaller ones: the smart party fights with fire and patience, the other with a sword. The gel is acid: contact wears down the party.
mechanics.flavor: Never feed a slime after midnight, they said.

mechanics.name: The Splitting Gel: Bloodprice
mechanics.desc: A great gelatinous thing and the knowledge that every blow that kills it makes two smaller ones: the smart party fights with fire and patience, the other with a sword. It answers the dungeon's deaths: every few kills in the area set it off.
mechanics.flavor: Never feed a slime after midnight, they said.

mechanics.name: The Frenzy of Wounded Prey
mechanics.desc: The things in this room can smell weakness: let a delver drop below half health and the whole pack goes wild, faster and harder, until someone stops the bleeding.
mechanics.flavor: Blood in the water.

mechanics.name: The Frenzy of Wounded Prey: The Hunters' Feast
mechanics.desc: The things in this room can smell weakness: let a delver drop below half health and the whole pack goes wild, faster and harder, until someone stops the bleeding. The pack also recovers a third of its health.
mechanics.flavor: Blood in the water.

mechanics.name: The Frenzy of Wounded Prey: Omen
mechanics.desc: The things in this room can smell weakness: let a delver drop below half health and the whole pack goes wild, faster and harder, until someone stops the bleeding. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: Blood in the water.

mechanics.name: The Frenzy of Wounded Prey: Keystone
mechanics.desc: The things in this room can smell weakness: let a delver drop below half health and the whole pack goes wild, faster and harder, until someone stops the bleeding. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: Blood in the water.

mechanics.name: The Frenzy of Wounded Prey: Frightening Frenzy
mechanics.desc: The things in this room can smell weakness: let a delver drop below half health and the whole pack goes wild, faster and harder, until someone stops the bleeding. The howl rattles the delvers too.
mechanics.flavor: Blood in the water.

mechanics.name: The Frenzy of Wounded Prey: Backlash
mechanics.desc: The things in this room can smell weakness: let a delver drop below half health and the whole pack goes wild, faster and harder, until someone stops the bleeding. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
mechanics.flavor: Blood in the water.

mechanics.name: The Homunculus Core
mechanics.desc: The enemies here stitch themselves back together as fast as they are torn apart: somewhere in each is a red core, and while it holds, they live.
mechanics.flavor: A body is only a vessel. Break the stone.

mechanics.name: The Homunculus Core: The Fast Regeneration
mechanics.desc: The enemies here stitch themselves back together as fast as they are torn apart: somewhere in each is a red core, and while it holds, they live. Even faster: a fifth restored each time.
mechanics.flavor: A body is only a vessel. Break the stone.

mechanics.name: The Homunculus Core: Threshold
mechanics.desc: The enemies here stitch themselves back together as fast as they are torn apart: somewhere in each is a red core, and while it holds, they live. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: A body is only a vessel. Break the stone.

mechanics.name: The Homunculus Core: Warded
mechanics.desc: The enemies here stitch themselves back together as fast as they are torn apart: somewhere in each is a red core, and while it holds, they live. It is held up by wardens that spawn with it; kill them all to end it.
mechanics.flavor: A body is only a vessel. Break the stone.

mechanics.name: The Homunculus Core: The Many Cores
mechanics.desc: The enemies here stitch themselves back together as fast as they are torn apart: somewhere in each is a red core, and while it holds, they live. Each regeneration also calls a servant.
mechanics.flavor: A body is only a vessel. Break the stone.

mechanics.name: The Homunculus Core: Backlash
mechanics.desc: The enemies here stitch themselves back together as fast as they are torn apart: somewhere in each is a red core, and while it holds, they live. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
mechanics.flavor: A body is only a vessel. Break the stone.

mechanics.name: The Gate Guardian
mechanics.desc: A gate boss waits in front of the dungeon's door, an elite knight with a retinue: the guardian only moves when the hunters step into its line.
mechanics.flavor: A-rank gates have always had a boss.

mechanics.name: The Gate Guardian: Twin Guardians
mechanics.desc: A gate boss waits in front of the dungeon's door, an elite knight with a retinue: the guardian only moves when the hunters step into its line. Two elites in place of one.
mechanics.flavor: A-rank gates have always had a boss.

mechanics.name: The Gate Guardian: Omen
mechanics.desc: A gate boss waits in front of the dungeon's door, an elite knight with a retinue: the guardian only moves when the hunters step into its line. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: A-rank gates have always had a boss.

mechanics.name: The Gate Guardian: Warded
mechanics.desc: A gate boss waits in front of the dungeon's door, an elite knight with a retinue: the guardian only moves when the hunters step into its line. It is held up by wardens that spawn with it; kill them all to end it.
mechanics.flavor: A-rank gates have always had a boss.

mechanics.name: The Gate Guardian: The Iron Guardian
mechanics.desc: A gate boss waits in front of the dungeon's door, an elite knight with a retinue: the guardian only moves when the hunters step into its line. A heavier guardian, plated against wounds.
mechanics.flavor: A-rank gates have always had a boss.

mechanics.name: The Gate Guardian: Gaze
mechanics.desc: A gate boss waits in front of the dungeon's door, an elite knight with a retinue: the guardian only moves when the hunters step into its line. It wakes when someone looks straight at it.
mechanics.flavor: A-rank gates have always had a boss.

mechanics.name: The Nen Beast Hunt
mechanics.desc: A conjured beast has marked one of the delvers and hunts that scent through the room; the others see the glow and are told, with some glee, to keep the marked one alive.
mechanics.flavor: The target is not the strongest. The target is the one who showed fear.

mechanics.name: The Nen Beast Hunt: Chain of Binding
mechanics.desc: A conjured beast has marked one of the delvers and hunts that scent through the room; the others see the glow and are told, with some glee, to keep the marked one alive. A chain binds the marked one to a second delver: both are in the beast's eye.
mechanics.flavor: The target is not the strongest. The target is the one who showed fear.

mechanics.name: The Nen Beast Hunt: Omen
mechanics.desc: A conjured beast has marked one of the delvers and hunts that scent through the room; the others see the glow and are told, with some glee, to keep the marked one alive. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: The target is not the strongest. The target is the one who showed fear.

mechanics.name: The Nen Beast Hunt: Keystone
mechanics.desc: A conjured beast has marked one of the delvers and hunts that scent through the room; the others see the glow and are told, with some glee, to keep the marked one alive. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: The target is not the strongest. The target is the one who showed fear.

mechanics.name: The Nen Beast Hunt: The Swift Beast
mechanics.desc: A conjured beast has marked one of the delvers and hunts that scent through the room; the others see the glow and are told, with some glee, to keep the marked one alive. It is quick and strikes first.
mechanics.flavor: The target is not the strongest. The target is the one who showed fear.

mechanics.name: The Nen Beast Hunt: Quorum
mechanics.desc: A conjured beast has marked one of the delvers and hunts that scent through the room; the others see the glow and are told, with some glee, to keep the marked one alive. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
mechanics.flavor: The target is not the strongest. The target is the one who showed fear.

mechanics.name: The Floor Guardian's Aura
mechanics.desc: The more delvers stand together, the harder the guardian's aura hits: a lone fighter faces lesser creatures, a full party faces a boss's retinue in rage.
mechanics.flavor: Do you really think you can defeat me with so many?

mechanics.name: The Floor Guardian's Aura: Aura of the Crowd
mechanics.desc: The more delvers stand together, the harder the guardian's aura hits: a lone fighter faces lesser creatures, a full party faces a boss's retinue in rage. It needs three delvers to wake.
mechanics.flavor: Do you really think you can defeat me with so many?

mechanics.name: The Floor Guardian's Aura: Threshold
mechanics.desc: The more delvers stand together, the harder the guardian's aura hits: a lone fighter faces lesser creatures, a full party faces a boss's retinue in rage. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: Do you really think you can defeat me with so many?

mechanics.name: The Floor Guardian's Aura: Keystone
mechanics.desc: The more delvers stand together, the harder the guardian's aura hits: a lone fighter faces lesser creatures, a full party faces a boss's retinue in rage. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: Do you really think you can defeat me with so many?

mechanics.name: The Floor Guardian's Aura: Aura of Regeneration
mechanics.desc: The more delvers stand together, the harder the guardian's aura hits: a lone fighter faces lesser creatures, a full party faces a boss's retinue in rage. The aura mends the guardian's followers as well.
mechanics.flavor: Do you really think you can defeat me with so many?

mechanics.name: The Floor Guardian's Aura: Omen
mechanics.desc: The more delvers stand together, the harder the guardian's aura hits: a lone fighter faces lesser creatures, a full party faces a boss's retinue in rage. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: Do you really think you can defeat me with so many?

mechanics.name: The Rounds of Initiative
